einzeiler: Shifts in the sports card hobby, new formats, and market trends
kurzfassung: Ryan Alford, Brian Ludden, and Bella discuss current shifts in the sports card hobby. They examine Topps Instant Packs and the implications of digital ripping for collectors and breakers. Additionally, they cover card collections, vintage and junk-wax-era cards, and market trends.
stichpunkte: Topps Instant Packs and digital ripping of physical cards
A recently acquired card collection and a Peyton Manning 1/1 discovery
Growing interest in older inserts, pop culture cards, and junk-wax-era cards
Shaq and Tim Duncan cards, plus Football scan data
beschreibung:
Ryan Alford, Brian Ludden and Bella are back with another Collector Nation hobby roundtable covering the latest shifts in sports cards, from new technology to overlooked vintage and junk-wax-era cards.
The crew breaks down Topps Instant Packs after Ryan tries the new $100 format himself, debating what digital ripping of real physical cards could mean for collectors, hobby shops, breakers, vaulting and card resale. Ryan also explains why breakers may have an overlooked advantage when major cards are pulled and buyers want immediate liquidity.
They also talk about the massive card collection Ryan recently picked up, the unexpected Peyton Manning 1/1 hiding inside it, growing interest in older inserts and pop culture cards, the iconic Bo Jackson card, football season returning and what’s next for Collector Station and Collector Nation.
